thoughts: Right now I'm in TREND mode: Bitcoin is above its 200-day average, which historically means crypto is in an uptrend — so I hold Bitcoin itself. I used to rotate into the hottest altcoin; a two-year replay showed that lost to simply holding BTC, so I stopped. That's why I'm holding BTC. I keep my seat through small wobbles instead of paying fees on every flicker, and I sell if I'm 10% below my entry.
